title: The Devil Screams in Sasazuka
overview: Maou and company face their usual budget crisis while Emi and Suzuno attempt to have a conversation next door. It's the same old, same old... except that today, they sense an ominous presence. Before long, a bloodcurdling scream will rend the night.

title: The Devil and the Hero Inconceivably Become Parents
overview: Alas Ramus seems dead set on the idea that Maou and Emi are her parents. After a few attempts at babysitting by Maou and Ashiya, though, it's clear that Chiho is the only one ready to cope with the realities of parenting. Her boss at MgRonald's isn't thrilled about all of this, but Chiho may have a future in the Devil's army.

title: The Devil and the Hero Go to the Amusement Park as Advised
overview: Maou, Emi, and Alas Ramus have an eventful day at the amusement park. Meanwhile, their three stalkers do their not-so-great best to blend in.

title: The Devil Learns the Pain of Losing Something Precious
overview: Emi attends a sleepover at the Devil's Castle. But in the morning, the fight for Alas Ramus and the sacred sword begins. Will Maou and Emi win? Will Gabriel take what's precious? Will there be a magical girl transformation sequence?!

title: The Devil Is at Sea After Losing His Home and His Job
overview: Alas Ramus may be safe, but Maou and his roommates have a few more crises to face. Luckily, they have strong allies on their side.

title: The Hero Helps the Devil Reequip His Workplace
overview: With Ohguro's new and improved look, business is booming! In fact, there are more customers than Maou and his team can handle alone. And at night, there are ominous shadows in the fog...

title: The Devil Learns That Choshi (and the World) Are Bigger Than He Knew
overview: Emi, Maou, and the gang learn the source of the recent demon invasion, as well as some surprising facts about Choshi City and their boss.

title: The Devil Begins Farming
overview: Maou, Ashiya, and Urushihara get a farming job on Chiho's recommendation. Emi seems to have some feelings about it.

title: The Devil and the Hero Rise Up to Defend the Sasakis
overview: Thieves and demons and bears, oh my!

title: The Devil Adamantly Insists on Buying a TV
overview: Maou thirsts for a TV, Emi learns some shocking news, and Urushihara schools us all on how to be proper NEETs.

title: The Devil Preaches Human Interaction
overview: Buying the Devil's TV is more exciting than anyone expected. Unrelatedly, Maou is wiser about human relationships than anyone expected.

title: The Devil and the Hero Focus on What's Happening Right Now
overview: The whole gang prepares for their showdown with Raguel. But the fight has a lot of unexpected twists and turns, thanks to meddling from more than one immortal.
